items.heading: Job Notices Are the Best
items.text: Job notices are the best live evidence. Read ten notices for the role you want and mark each line as a hard skill (tool, task, subject) or a soft skill (communication, ownership, teamwork). You will see a pattern in what is a must and what is a bonus.

items.heading: A Narrow Service, Such As
items.text: A narrow service, such as bookkeeping for shops or reports for clinics, mixes a hard skill with soft skills that keep clients.
